en.name: iEventSpark
en.short_description: Event hosting, guest lists and door check-in
en.subtitle: Host events, check guests in
en.description:
EventSpark helps you run your own events from your phone.

HOSTING
Create an event with a date, venue, capacity and a single ticket price (or free entry). Keep the guest list, add guests yourself, check them in at the door with their code, see who has arrived, and read the numbers for each event afterwards. Copy the event details as text to share them in any message.

GOING
Public event listings, prices and ticket checkout are coming soon. Until the ticketing partnerships are signed, the app says so plainly instead of showing sample events, organisers, agendas or prices. Selling tickets online for your own events is not available yet either.

YOURS
There are no accounts and no sign-in. Your hosted events, guest lists and saved events are stored only on your device, and Settings lets you delete all of them. To help us fix problems, the app sends anonymous crash reports, performance measurements and usage statistics to Google Firebase.

ADS
The app shows ads from Google AdMob. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads. The app does not ask for permission to track you, and where the law requires consent (for example in the EEA and the UK) you are asked before any ad is requested and can change your choice later in Settings.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
EventSpark helps you run your own events from your phone.

Intended audience:
Host events, check guests in

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Google AdMob (ads): banner ads on the browsing screens (Discover, Search, Nearby, Tickets, Host, Saved, organiser pages) and an occasional, frequency-capped full-screen ad when the user switches tabs. No ads on event details, checkout, a ticket's own page, door check-in, the live room, event creation and editing, guest lists, or Settings and the other Menu screens. Ad requests wait for Google's UMP consent where it is required; the app does not request App Tracking Transparency permission. Where consent applies, Settings shows a Privacy choices row to change it.
- Google Firebase: Crashlytics (crash reports), Analytics (anonymous usage statistics), Performance Monitoring and Remote Config. Collection is enabled in release builds. No account and no personal data such as names, guest lists or event details are sent.
- The privacy policy (https://www.americangroup.ai/policy/eventspark/) opens in the system browser, and Contact support opens the mail app.
There is no video-calling service, no payment service and no sign-in service.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app follows the device language for 12 locales (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish), but translation is partial: shared labels are translated, while most screen text is in English only. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
